name: infinightcapture
description: Gesture-reactive webcam mocap compositor with Syphon and Spout output targets.

scripts.launch: npm run build && npm run electron:preview
scripts.package:mac: npm run native:build && npm run build && electron-packager . INFINIGHTCapture --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --extend-info=electron/Info.plist --extra-resource=native/build/SyphonFramePublisher --ignore='^/(release|src|native)(/|$)'
